additional_info.subject: ID0475029-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / PN 170001094] LED Stuck in blue CRM:03289000389
additional_info.body:
Dear Simen,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
Following a review of the information provided, we’re pleased to confirm you:
Session Stops with "No PLC Link":
Our review indicates that the electric vehicle (EV) itself initiated the stop.
"Low Voltage from EVSE" Observations:
Our review indicates that this issue is related to a software anomaly.
Charging LED:
Regarding your observation about the charging LED, Could you please confirm if you are still observing this specific LED behaviours?
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0475029-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / PN 170001094] LED Stuck in blue CRM:03289000389

Hi,
Okay so
Point 1 is EV issue
Point 2 is software bug?
Point 3 LED was normal again after they triggered a reboot. Question was why the charger put the LED in charging when pilot was changed to A. Didn’t see any logical reason in the logs.
/Simen
